metadata.name: Louisiana Airport Construction and Development Priority Program
metadata.agency: Louisiana Department of Transportation and Development, Aviation Division
metadata.source_citation: Louisiana Aviation Program Policy Manual, Effective July 1, 2024, Version 1.2. Reference: LA Adm Code Title 70, Part IX. Encoded from source PDF at Priority_Model/Example Prioritization Models/Louisiana-aviation-program-policy-manual-july-1-2024.pdf.

decisions_log.author: APH m49 reference encoder
decisions_log.decision: Encoded Louisiana model with eligibility_gate enabled (two-step process)
decisions_log.rationale: Louisiana's process is explicitly two-step per the source: 'Step One – determine project eligibility / Step Two – confirm all required information is available'. The eligibility_gate captures step one before scoring runs.
decisions_log.source: Louisiana Aviation Policy Manual; NASP Symposium - LADOTD deck

decisions_log.author: APH m49 reference encoder
decisions_log.decision: Used additive_100pt with four categories per the LADOTD deck
decisions_log.rationale: LADOTD's NASP presentation explicitly identifies four categories: Project Type, Facility Usage, Sponsor Compliance, Special Considerations. Specific point allocations within each category live in LA Adm Code Title 70 Part IX Ch 3 and require the user to populate from their adopted statute.

decisions_log.author: APH m49 reference encoder
decisions_log.decision: Set air carrier set-aside via ACE program percentage
decisions_log.rationale: Louisiana's Air Carrier Enhancement (ACE) Program reserves 21.622% of total air carrier allocation amount through the prioritized program for FY2025-2026.

filters.label: Eligible Airport Sponsor
filters.rule: Sponsor must be a state agency, city, town, parish, airport authority, airport commission, airport district, or other political subdivision that owns/operates/leases/controls a public-use airport or landing area.

filters.label: Public-Use Airport
filters.rule: Project must be at a publicly owned, public-use airport in the Louisiana Airport System (excludes non-NPIAS rural strips by default).

filters.label: Non-Prioritized Project Categories
filters.rule: Projects falling under Manual Table 1.2 (Non-Prioritized Projects) are excluded from the priority program.

filters.label: Minimum Pre-Application Criteria
filters.rule: Project must meet the minimum criteria outlined in Manual Table 2.8 (Airport Project Pre-Application Minimum Criteria).

criteria.label: Project Type
criteria.description: Category I — what the project is. Specific point values live in LA Adm Code Title 70 Part IX Ch 3 and Manual Table 3.3 Project Components. Defaults below are placeholder tiers using regex matches against project_type; states adopting this model should replace with statute-specific values.

subcategories.label: Safety-critical airside (RSA, OFA, RPZ, obstruction removal, ARFF)

criteria.label: Facility Usage
criteria.description: Category II — based on Louisiana Aviation System Plan (LASP) classification, based aircraft, and operations levels.

criteria.label: Sponsor Compliance
criteria.description: Category III — sponsor's compliance posture: inspection score, certification status, grant performance history.

subcategories.label: Most recent public-use airport inspection passed
Based aircraft scoring documented per Manual 5.8
Active grant performance discrepancies (per Manual Table 8.5)

criteria.label: Special Considerations
criteria.description: Category IV — local funding contribution, leveraging factors, and other special considerations per Manual Section 3.2.2.

subcategories.label: Sponsor local funding contribution exceeds required match

set_asides.label: Air Carrier Enhancement (ACE) Program
set_asides.eligibility_filter: Air carrier airports under the prioritized airport construction and development priority program. Statute-defined allocation percentages per Manual Appendix A.

governance.decision_authority: Louisiana DOTD Aviation Division (with legislative approval per LA Adm Code Title 70 Part IX)
governance.statute_citation: LA Adm Code Title 70, Part IX, Subpart A, Chapter 3 (Airport Construction and Development Priority Program). LA Revised Statutes Title 2, Aeronautics.
governance.scoring_authority: DOTD Aviation Division Development line of business
governance.approval_process: Two-step process: (1) eligibility determination, (2) confirmation of required information. Programmed projects shall be included within the Airport Construction and Development Priority Program. Funding flows through total approved calculated amounts for each airport and category. Subject to legislative approval; airport sponsors review draft program before legislative submission.

disclaimer: This model encoding is derived from the Louisiana Aviation Program Policy Manual (July 2024) and references LA Adm Code Title 70 Part IX. Specific point allocations within each category are placeholder tiers; states adopting this model should replace with their statute's exact values. The ACE Program 21.622% allocation reflects FY2025-2026 percentages and changes annually.
